title: What do you check during air condition maintenance?
desc: Lubricate moving parts, Check thermostat settings, Inspect, and clean the air filter or replace it, if it is deteriorated and can’t be used further, Tighten all electrical connection, Check system control

title: What causes the aircon to damage?
desc: Lack of appropriate maintenance damages your Ac

title: What kills air conditioner compressors?
desc: No servicing is the reason behind it.
